scope: Two-task development preparation for the public RoboTwin 2.0 SFT-to-RECAP baseline; no final test or candidate-method claim
sampling: One real observation before every qpos environment action, plus the actual final post-action observation; no frame interpolation
fps_semantics: Nominal LeRobot indexing frequency, one sample per RoboTwin take_action(qpos) command; not measured physical simulation or wall-clock frequency
selection: First32 verified training successes in seed-index order per task; report insufficiency rather than collecting until a success quota
